def build_agent(sandbox):

    beam1 = sandbox.add_beam(x=10.0, y=5.0, width=2.0, height=2.0, density=10.0)
    
    # Left vertical beam anchored at x=6.0, y=5.0 (center at x=6.0, y=6.5)
    beam2 = sandbox.add_beam(x=6.0, y=6.5, width=0.5, height=2.0, density=10.0)
    
    # Right vertical beam anchored at x=14.0, y=5.0 (center at x=14.0, y=6.5)
    beam3 = sandbox.add_beam(x=14.0, y=6.5, width=0.5, height=2.0, density=10.0)
    
    # Top horizontal beam at y=8.0 (centered at x=10.0)
    beam4 = sandbox.add_beam(x=10.0, y=8.0, width=2.0, height=2.0, density=10.0)
    
    # Bottom horizontal beam at y=1.5 (centered at x=10.0)
    beam5 = sandbox.add_beam(x=10.0, y=1.5, width=2.0, height=2.0, density=10.0)
    
    # Rigid joints connecting central beam to other beams
    # Central to left vertical
    sandbox.add_joint(beam1, beam2, (6.0, 5.0), type='rigid')
    # Central to right vertical
    sandbox.add_joint(beam1, beam3, (14.0, 5.0), type='rigid')
    # Central to top beam
    sandbox.add_joint(beam1, beam4, (10.0, 8.0), type='rigid')
    # Central to bottom beam
    sandbox.add_joint(beam1, beam5, (10.0, 1.5), type='rigid')
    
    # Pivot joints at the base of the vertical beams
    # Left vertical to ground
    sandbox.add_joint(beam2, None, (6.0, 5.0), type='pivot')
    # Right vertical to ground
    sandbox.add_joint(beam3, None, (14.0, 5.0), type='pivot')
    
    return beam1
